sentences.text: Yuzhoulong is a macronarian sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic of Chongqing, China, named after the ancient name for the region.
The known remains consist of a partial skeleton with a partial skull belonging to an immature subadult individual.
The holotype fossil CLGRP V00013 was discovered in 2016 in Pu'an town, Yunyang County, Chongqing.
Dai and colleagues named the genus and species Yuzhoulong qurenensis in 2022.
The fossil was found partially buried in rock mixed with fossils of another unnamed sauropod species.
Phylogenetic analyses consistently classify Yuzhoulong as a basal macronarian.
Yuzhoulong is classified within the class Saurischia.
Yuzhoulong lived during the Middle Jurassic in the Shaximiao Formation of Chongqing, China.
The time range for Yuzhoulong is estimated to be between 168.2 and 161.5 million years ago.
